name: Split.io
description: Split.io, now Harness Feature Management & Experimentation, provides feature flags, targeting, progressive delivery, experimentation, and release monitoring.
agentUseSummary: Connect an API_FEATURE_FLAG_VIEWER Admin API key scoped to one non-production project/workspace. Relay approval-gates a bounded metadata list and exact flag read; environment definitions, targeting, treatments, identities, owners, experiments, and mutations remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: SPLIT_IO_FEATURE_FLAG_VIEWER_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Split.io Feature Flag Viewer Admin API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use an API_FEATURE_FLAG_VIEWER key scoped to one project/workspace.

credentialRequirements.name: SPLIT_IO_WORKSPACE_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Split.io project/workspace ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind Relay to the same non-production project/workspace as the key.

capabilities.label: Read feature-flag metadata
capabilities.description: Read bounded project-level feature-flag metadata with approval.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Admin API keys, Bearer headers, stored workspace routing, and credential-bearing fields never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Read targeting or identities
blocked.description: Environment definitions, treatments, rules, segments, keys, attributes, owners, users, identities, impressions, metrics, and experiments are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate Split.io
blocked.description: Flag creation, updates, rollout changes, kill/restore/archive/delete, definitions, change requests, segments, keys, users, projects, and every other mutation remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only project-level flag list and exact metadata GETs run on api.split.io with stored workspace binding; arbitrary routes, environments, queries, pagination, SDK evaluation, exports, and raw API access are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both bounded metadata reads require approval; Viewer role/workspace scope, response bounds, redaction, audits, and definition/evaluation/mutation blocks remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected metadata read runs without Relay per-action approval; Viewer role/workspace scope, response bounds, redaction, audits, and definition/evaluation/mutation blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway attaches the encrypted workspace-scoped Viewer key server-side and mounts two approval-gated metadata reads.
Railway attaches the encrypted workspace-scoped Viewer key server-side and mounts two approval-gated metadata reads.

providerSetup.blocker: Split.io requires a customer account and an Admin API key assigned API_FEATURE_FLAG_VIEWER and one project/workspace scope. No console, account, key, project, environment, flag, Railway environment, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create the restricted key outside this worker, configure its encrypted value and workspace ID in Railway staging, then verify role/scope binding, list/exact redaction, approval/access denial, response bounds, revocation, pause/disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Split documents the workspace-bound list route, offset/limit bounds, response shape, and API_FEATURE_FLAG_VIEWER plus WORKSPACE access requirements.
Split documents the exact project-level metadata GET and sensitive owner data Relay excludes.
Split documents immutable Admin API key roles/scopes, API_FEATURE_FLAG_VIEWER as view-only, project/environment restriction, revocation, and least-privilege behavior.
